capabilities: Summon a note picker from any application with a global hotkey
Search notes by filename and path, or create a note by typing a new name
Edit notes in native Obsidian floating editor windows
Hide floating notes with Esc and recall them with editor state preserved
Resize, pin always-on-top, and reopen recent notes
disambiguation: Not a note-organization tool; it manages floating editor windows and a quick picker, not note content or structure.
extras: Desktop-only (Obsidian 1.13.1+); not intended for mobile. Search matches filenames and paths, not note contents. Plugin ID changed from obsidian-floating-note-manager to floating-note-manager in 0.1.23, and the README includes a manual migration procedure; the two IDs are treated as separate plugins. Works locally with no network services or telemetry.
problem: Opening or jotting a note normally means switching to the main Obsidian window, which interrupts work in other applications.
summary: Desktop-only plugin that searches, creates, and edits Markdown notes in native floating Obsidian windows, summonable via an optional global shortcut.
